name: search
description: Search file contents for a regex pattern; returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers, recursively when path is a directory. 'Find', 'locate', or 'grep' requests are tool-use tasks - use search, not memory. First step when finding where something is defined (e.g. query='def test_'); when filenames are already known, read_file directly instead. If the task requires modifying code, follow up with read_file and edit_file - search results alone don't satisfy edit_file's read_file prerequisite.

query.description: Regex pattern to search for (extended regex).

path.description: File or directory to search in (default: current directory).
